item.title: RTT: Public selections for fixed-term tenure track researchers (RTT) (Univ. MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-21 12:00
Institution: Univ. MILANO, Milano
Field: Earth sciences / 04/GEOS-01 Mineralogia, petrologia, geochimica, vulcanologia, georisorse e applicazioni

Public competition for the recruitment of 1 fixed-term tenure track researcher (RTT), by stipulating a 6-year subordinate employment agreement, pursuant to art. 24 of Law no. 240/2010 of 30/12/2010, as amended by art. 14 paragraph 6-decies of Law Decree no. 36/2022 of 30/04/2022, converted with amendments into Law no. 79/2022 of 29/6/2022, for carrying out research and didactic activities, integrative didactic and service activities for students.
